description: This file defines the 'ProductReview' entity class, which models customer reviews for products in the sales management system. It includes properties for ratings, review date, status, customer info, product info, and review descriptions, along with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: ProductReview
classes.description: Entity class representing a product review, including review details, associations to customer and product, and audit information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the review.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the review.

methods.name: getReviewRead
methods.description: Retrieves the number of times the review has been read.

methods.name: setReviewRead
methods.description: Sets the number of times the review has been read.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Gets the current status of the review.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the review.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the customer who made the review.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Associates a customer with this review.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the product associated with the review.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with this review.

methods.name: getReviewDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the review was made.
